items.description:
Alpha Sand & Stone Plant Hire has supplied building sand, stone and plant hire from its Ladanna yard since 1971. Its sand range includes builder's mix for econo-concrete work, river sand for concrete and paving, building sand for mortar, plaster sand for interior and exterior walls, and topsoil for gardens and lawns.

Its stone range comes from a quarry that supplies granite aggregates for concrete manufacturing and civil construction, in sizes from 7.1 mm to 20 mm, along with crusher sand and scalping sand. The business also offers TLB and abnormal lowbed plant hire, delivers within about 80 km of Polokwane, and says it prides itself on excellent customer service.

Cash Crusaders at Savannah Mall is a buy-sell-trade retailer that sells pre-owned phones, home entertainment, appliances, power tools and gaming equipment, alongside new products. The store says it offers the best prices, a warranty for peace of mind and good customer service.

Customers can sell goods for cash, use valuables to secure a 30-day loan, and get a price on an item through WhatsApp, with the option to chat with a salesperson or buyer by video call. The store also offers buy online and collect in store, and it trades from Shop G10 and G11 on the corner of Thabo Mbeki and Grimm Streets in Fauna Park.

Designer Pool Covers supplies and installs pool covers and pool safety products from its Superbia branch at 39 Nikkel Street in Polokwane Extension 13. The company says it has served pool owners across Limpopo since 2012, with a product line designed to enhance safety, reduce maintenance and improve energy efficiency.

A 2024 press release says the Polokwane branch extends its services to Thohoyandou, Mokopane and Phalaborwa, and the company says it tailors its solutions to the climate and needs of pool owners in the province. Homeowners and businesses with pools in the area can contact the branch about pool cover options.

Eskulaap Hotel is a hotel and conference venue in the heart of Polokwane, at 54 Rissik Street, set in a tranquil and secure environment. Its air-conditioned rooms include doubles, twin rooms and a spacious family unit for up to four guests, with free Wi-Fi throughout.

The hotel has a hectare of landscaped gardens, an on-site restaurant, a swimming pool and conference facilities for up to 120 delegates. Guests get secure parking and convenient access to shopping centres, hospitals and main routes, and the hotel advises early booking because rooms are limited. It suits business travellers, couples and families visiting Polokwane.

FAW Polokwane is an authorised FAW dealership in Nirvana, part of the BB Group dealer network, selling and servicing commercial trucks from its Tagore Street premises. The range includes freight carriers, tippers and truck-tractors, and the dealership also handles used vehicles and parts.

Its contact page lists separate departments for new sales, used sales, parts and the workshop, so fleet owners and transport operators can speak to the right team directly. Operators who need a truck for freight, tipping or long-distance work can compare models and get servicing and parts support in one place. The dealership is at 204 Tagore Street, Nirvana, Polokwane.

Fusion Boutique Hotel is a boutique hotel in Polokwane Central with a dedicated wedding venue. The Apprentice Ballroom seats 250 guests and is decorated in black and gold, with state-of-the-art equipment, a PA system, a choice of chairs, and basic table linen, crockery and glassware.

The hotel also has a rooftop venue for ceremonies, with views over the Polokwane skyline, and cellar spaces for smaller events. A wedding coordinator and team advise couples on every aspect of the day, and a food tasting and private menu meeting with the chef can be arranged. The hotel has 33 bedrooms and themed guest suites, and its bridal couples are offered a complimentary night in the Kiss Executive Suite.

Good Hope Primary School is a public, no-fee primary school in Westenburg, Polokwane, at 47 Ben Harris Street. It is a Section 21 (self-reliant) school with a Quintile 3 classification, which means it serves a community with moderate socio-economic status.

The school teaches from Foundation Phase through to Grade 7, with around 1,300 learners and a staff of 35 teachers. Its School Register profile places the school in the Capricorn South education district and lists its contact details and location, so parents can check the address before a visit. The register gives the school's postal address as a PO Box in Westenburg, for families who prefer to write to the school.

Limpopo Structures is a structural steel engineering and manufacturing company in Ladanna, Polokwane, offering steel structure design, manufacturing and erection. The company has operated since 2003 and serves industrial and commercial clients across Limpopo and beyond.

Its website says the team and facilities are dedicated to quality and precision, and that it takes projects from design through to erection on site. Prospective clients are invited to discuss their project needs through the contact page. The website describes its expertise in structural steel engineering and says its steel manufacturing and erection services are completed to the highest standards. The company is based at 37 Platinum Street in Ladanna, Polokwane.

Mediclinic Limpopo is a private hospital in Hospital Park, Polokwane, with 193 beds. It serves the communities of Limpopo, Eastern and Northern Botswana and Northern Mpumalanga, and runs a 24-hour Emergency Centre for urgent care.

The hospital offers specialist surgical and medical care alongside a Cathlab, CT scanning, pathology and radiology services. Patients can find contact details and the full service list on the hospital's website. The Emergency Centre is open around the clock for urgent care, and the hospital describes its range of specialist care across medical and surgical services. The hospital is at 53 Plein Street in Hospital Park.

Osieteddies Kleinkindontwikkelingsentrum is an early childhood development centre and pre-school in Sterpark, registered in 2000, with seven classes for young children. The centre says it started small and has grown, and that its teachers have a great love for every child and expertise in their field.

The programme combines learning through play, creative thinking and problem-solving with outdoor movement and role-play, and every class has a fantasy area for pretend play. Weekly activities include baking and mixing, and the curriculum covers language, maths, computer skills, science, music, drama, art and physical development. The centre is at 21 and 23 Munnik Lane in Sterpark.

Pietersburg Motor & Diesel Services is a commercial truck and bus service and repairs workshop on Lood Street in Futura, Polokwane, with 25 years of experience. The workshop repairs trucks, buses, trailers and generator sets, and it is an accredited Shacman workshop.

The business works on Scania, MAN, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo and Shacman vehicles and offers a 24/7 breakdown service. Its skilled team serves customers across Limpopo, and its website carries testimonials from clients who praise consistent service. Its website presents the company as a long-standing workshop whose team is fully equipped for all service and repair needs. Fleet owners who need reliable workshop support for commercial vehicles can contact the workshop at 43 Lood Street.

items.description:
Signature Cosmetics Mall of the North is a cosmetics and beauty products store trading inside Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane. Its place in the centre's own shop directory lists it specifically among the mall's beauty and personal care retailers, confirming that cosmetics and beauty products, rather than general merchandise, are what the store is built around.

The store gives shoppers already in the mall a dedicated stop for cosmetics and everyday beauty items without needing to leave the centre, making it a practical pick for anyone combining a beauty purchase with a wider shopping trip. It trades from Shop L66a on the corner of the R81 and N1, and keeps longer hours on weekdays from nine in the morning to seven at night, shortening to nine until five on weekends and public holidays.

Smile On Dental is a family and cosmetic dental practice at Metropolitan Building on Genl Joubert Street in Polokwane Central, part of a group with four branches across Pretoria and Polokwane. The practice offers general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and orthodontics, including routine cleaning and whitening, dental implants, and clear aligners and braces.

Patients can book an appointment online or request a callback, and they can choose their preferred branch. The practice follows a simple path from first contact to personal care: patients share what feels uncomfortable or what they want to improve, then their teeth, gums, bite and smile goals are reviewed before a recommendation is made. The website reports a 5.0 average rating from more than 60 patient reviews.

Sportsmans Warehouse Thornhill is a sporting and outdoor goods retailer trading inside Thornhill Shopping Centre in Polokwane. Thornhill's own centre directory places the store under its sport, outdoor goods and gear category, confirming that sporting and outdoor equipment, not a broader general range, is the store's focus at this branch.

Shoppers can use the branch as a dedicated stop for sport and outdoor gear while running other errands at the same centre, suiting anyone equipping themselves for hiking, camping, running, team sport or general outdoor activity without a special trip elsewhere. The store trades from Shop 61 in the centre, on the corner of Veldspaat and Munnik Avenue, and is open from nine until seven on weekdays, half past eight until five on Saturdays, and nine until three on Sundays.

items.description:
Supa-Roof Lebowakgomo is a branch of the national Supa-Roof chain, a specialist retailer supplying roofing products and complete roofing solutions to home builders and renovators. Its listing on Supa-Roof's own official store locator confirms the branch's roofing focus and gives its current trading address in Lebowakgomo.

The store serves customers who need roofing products and solutions for new building projects, renovations and repairs, from homeowners planning a roof replacement to builders sourcing materials for a client. It trades from Complex Stand 22, Shop 2, on the corner of Mohlala Road and Dihlabakela Street in Lebowakgomo, and is open from eight until five on weekdays and from half past seven until one on Saturdays, closed on Sundays.

items.description:
The Fix Paledi Mall is a clothing store trading inside Paledi Mall in Turfloop Township, Mankweng, stocking women's and children's clothing, shoes and fashion accessories. Its branch listing places it specifically among ladieswear and children's clothing retailers, giving a clearer picture of the range carried at this store than the brand's wider national positioning.

Shoppers visiting the mall can use the store as a stop for everyday and occasion wear for themselves and their children, along with footwear and accessories to complete an outfit, without having to travel further afield. The store trades from Shop 69 in Paledi Mall and is open daily from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon, making it accessible for both weekday and weekend shopping trips.

The Steakshop is a family-run butchery in Welgelegen, Polokwane, operating since 2010 with a philosophy of quality goods, friendly customer service and community-centred values. It was formerly known as Vleislapa Welgelegen and was rebranded as the Steakshop as it grew into one of the best known butcheries in the city.

The shop sells beef, lamb, chicken, mince, biltong and dry wors, braai packs, marinades, cold meats, bakery items, cakes and savoury treats. The business says it supports local farmers and sources its products locally, and customers can order online for home delivery within about 25 km around Polokwane. The shop is at 95 General Viljoen Street in Welgelegen.

TTS Polokwane is a Massey Ferguson tractor dealer in the Polokwane region of Limpopo, supplying tractors, implements, parts and service. The dealership sells new tractors and haymaking equipment, along with loaders and sprayers, and it offers genuine AGCO parts for the range.

The dealership also provides workshop and on-farm servicing, and its website lists a standby service for urgent work. The business describes its Massey Ferguson range as straightforward and dependable. The website invites visitors to view the range of equipment and to contact the team for service and parts enquiries. Farmers and agricultural businesses in the region can find the dealership at 9 Marmer Street in Magna Via, Polokwane.

Turfloop Printers & Stationary is a printing and stationery shop on University Road in Mankweng, serving University of Limpopo students and the surrounding community. It offers business cards, flyers, banners, brochures, invitations, logo printing, T-shirt printing and car stickers.

The shop also stocks stationery, from pens and pencils to notebooks and journals, and says it provides affordable, quality products for work or play. Its mission is to help businesses and individuals of all sizes reach their goals. Customers can view the shop's services and prices on its website, which gives an overview of its printing and stationery categories in one place before they visit.

Vodacom Shop Repairs is a cellular and telecommunications store trading inside Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, Polokwane. The mall's own shop directory lists the store among its electronics and cellular retailers, confirming that mobile products and related services are what this branch focuses on rather than a wider general retail range.

Customers can use the store for cellular products, mobile-related services and device repairs while they are at the mall for other shopping, making it a convenient stop for anyone needing a new handset, a repair or help with a mobile account. The store trades from Shop 11 to 14 in Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Streets, within the mall's general retail trading hours.

Alzu Feeds Polokwane is an animal feed depot in Polokwane Ext 2, part of the Alzu Group, supplying animal feeds and livestock-feed products including production meal for cattle and other livestock. The company's own published feed material identifies this Polokwane depot as part of its branch network, confirming that livestock feed, not general agricultural retail, is the depot's core business.

Livestock owners and other agricultural customers can source feed for their herds from this depot rather than relying on feed bought further afield, making it a practical supply point for farms and smallholdings in and around Polokwane. The depot trades from 20 Industria Street in Polokwane Extension 2.

items.description:
Carrol Boyes is a South African homeware brand trading from Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane, known for sculptural, functional-art metalware and tableware. The brand's own official website lists this branch among the stores where its products are stocked, and the mall's own shop directory independently confirms the store's presence, together pointing to a dedicated, branded homeware offering rather than a generic gift shop.

Customers shopping for homeware, decor pieces and gifts can visit the store for distinctive, design-led items to furnish a home or give as a present, rather than mass-produced alternatives. The store trades from Shop U85 in Mall of the North, on the R81.

Chicken Licken Fly-Thru is a fried-chicken fast-food outlet on Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, offering a drive-through alongside walk-in takeaway service. Current restaurant listings for the branch confirm it operates as a Fly-Thru format, meaning customers can order and collect without leaving their vehicle, in addition to ordering at the counter.

The outlet suits customers wanting a quick fried-chicken meal on the go, whether that is a stop on the way home, a takeaway for the family, or a late dinner run. It trades from 11B Grobler Street and keeps long hours, open from nine in the morning until nine at night from Sunday to Thursday, and until ten at night on Fridays and Saturdays.

Coco Affair is a coffee shop and bistro at Standard Bank Square on Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central, serving breakfast, light meals, high tea and South African-style food. Its business listing confirms the café also offers outside catering, takeaways and functions, extending its role beyond a sit-down coffee shop to events held off site.

The café suits customers meeting for breakfast or a light lunch, groups booking a high tea, and anyone needing catering for a function or an order to take away rather than eat in. It trades from Standard Bank Square and is open from eight in the morning until six in the evening on weekdays, and nine until two on Saturdays.

College of Africa is a private higher-education college with a campus in Mankweng, Polokwane. The college's own official website identifies this Mankweng site as one of its campuses and sets out how prospective students can apply, confirming the institution's presence and admissions process at this location.

Students looking to enrol can use the campus to begin the application process, submit the required documents and get guidance on the steps to admission before classes start. The college also publicises bursary opportunities for qualifying applicants through its website. The campus is on Hospital Road in the New Stands area of Gakoma, Mankweng, serving students from the surrounding Polokwane area who are looking to further their studies close to home.

FreshStop at Caltex Ivypark is a convenience store at the Caltex garage in Ivy Park, Polokwane, stocking prepared food, bread, snacks, beverages and confectionery. Current delivery-listing information for the store confirms this range and that it operates as a forecourt convenience shop rather than a full grocery outlet.

Motorists and local shoppers can use the store for a quick meal, a cold drink or everyday snacks and bread without needing a separate stop at a supermarket, making it a practical option when filling up or passing through on the way elsewhere. The store trades on the corner of Marshall Street and Nelson Mandela Avenue in Ivypark and stays open around the clock, every day of the week.

Shop 11 in Limpopo Mall, Polokwane Central, is home to a branch of John Craig, a menswear retailer confirmed by the brand's own official store locator as trading at this address. The locator lists this store alongside John Craig's other branches nationwide, confirming that menswear, rather than a wider family or ladieswear range, is what this particular store carries.

Men shopping for clothing can find this branch useful for building out a wardrobe in one visit, from everyday basics to smarter pieces, without needing to search elsewhere in the mall. Limpopo Mall sits within the block bounded by Rissik, Market, Devonish and Kerk Streets in Polokwane Central, putting the store within easy reach of other CBD shopping.

Laduma Hardware in Lebowakgomo is a hardware and building-materials store supplying buildware, tiles and bathroom ware, along with board cutting and edging, plan reading and general construction guidance. The branch's own page on the Laduma Hardware website states that this store opened in 2019 as the group's 15th and, at the time, its biggest store, marking it out from the chain's other outlets rather than being just another branch address.

The store serves home builders, renovators and other construction customers from Lebowakgomo and the surrounding areas, including Mmakotse, Hwelereng and Seponapudi, who need materials and practical advice for a building project under one roof. It trades on Jane Furse Road in Lebowakgomo.

items.description:
NJR Steel Polokwane is a steel and hardware merchant in Superbia, supplying round tubing, flat bar, roof sheets, security and palisade fencing, channels, steel beams, reinforcing mesh and rebar. The branch's own page on the NJR Steel website confirms this product range and adds cutting, welding, grinding and paint-related value-added services, along with collection or delivery and pricing sold directly to the public rather than trade only.

The branch serves customers across different sizes and industries, from individual homeowners needing fencing or roof sheeting to contractors and businesses sourcing structural steel for a larger project. It is open from seven until half past four on weekdays from Monday to Thursday, seven until four on Fridays, and eight until midday on Saturdays.

items.description:
Pietersburg Motor Centre is a used-vehicle dealership in Polokwane Central specialising in pre-owned vehicles, run across multiple sales floors on its premises. The dealership's own official website states that it opened to the public in July 1997 and has operated in the used-car market for more than twenty years, giving it a trading history well beyond that of a newer dealership in the same market.

Customers buying pre-owned passenger vehicles, bakkies and other used vehicles can browse stock across the dealership's sales floors rather than a single showroom, with a long-running dealer behind the sale rather than an unfamiliar private seller. The dealership trades from 10 Grobler Street in Polokwane Central.

items.description:
Plumblink Polokwane is a plumbing, bathroom and kitchenware retailer and supplier, part of the national Plumblink network. The branch's own current page on the Plumblink website confirms this product range and gives the store's present trading address, which differs from older listings still circulating for the branch.

Customers needing plumbing fixtures and fittings, bathroom ware or kitchen-related products can source them from the branch whether they are a plumber buying for a job or a homeowner working on a renovation. The store trades from Kobalt Street in Polokwane Extension 13, and is open from seven until half past four on weekdays from Monday to Thursday, seven until four on Fridays, and eight until one on Saturdays.
